assets.caption: EXHIBIT 7-1 Basic Furnace Operation — hand-drawn cutaway elevation diagram of a basic process furnace showing stack, damper, breeching, convection section (with steam in / superheated steam out), radiant section with vertical wall tubes, product in / heated product out, two floor burners with air and fuel, peep door, insulation, and three draft-gauge (DG) taps reading -.7", -.5", and -2" (inches of water column).
